blocks.text: International pickleball athlete Gabe Tardio is set to meet Filipino pickleball fans and players at 2XU Opus Mall on September 19, bringing international-level performance closer to one of the country’s growing sporting communities. The exclusive meet-and-greet brings together 2XU Philippines and Facolos Philippines in a performance-led collaboration designed to connect Filipino players and fans with an international athlete while celebrating the momentum of pickleball in the Philippines. Tardio’s Philippine visit is made possible by Supreme Legacy Sports–Facolos Philippines, with Source Masters, Inc., 2XU Brand House Partner , supporting the initiative and helping bring the experience directly to the local performance community.
